# Spotify Project

Authors: [Bernacchia Alessia](https://github.com/AlessiaBernacchia), [Pioda Tommaso](https://github.com/Thetommigun432), [Villani Giacomo](https://github.com/DownToTheGround)


```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidymodels)

billboard <- read_csv("billboard.csv", 
                           col_types = cols(url = col_skip(), 
                            song = col_skip(), song = col_skip(), 
                            performer = col_skip(), 
                            instance = col_skip()
                            ))

audio_features <- read_csv("audio_features.csv", 
                           col_types = cols(song_id = col_skip(), 
                            performer = col_skip(), song = col_skip(), 
                            spotify_genre = col_skip(), 
                            spotify_track_preview_url = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_explicit = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_album = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_album = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_id = col_skip()
                            ))

audio_features <- na.omit(audio_features)

print(head(audio_features,10))

audio_features_g <- read_csv("audio_features.csv", 
                           col_types = cols( 
                            performer = col_skip(), song = col_skip(), 
                            spotify_genre = col_skip(), 
                            spotify_track_preview_url = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_explicit = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_album = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_album = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_id = col_skip()
                            ))

audio_features_g <- na.omit(audio_features_g)


full_data <- left_join(billboard, audio_features_g, by = "song_id")

full_data$previous_week_position[is.na(full_data$previous_week_position)] <- 0

full_data_clean <- full_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(spotify_track_popularity))

full_data_clean <- full_data_clean %>%
  mutate(top30 = ifelse(week_position <= 30, 1, 0))

full_data_clean <- full_data_clean %>% select(-c(song_id, week_id, week_position))

print(colSums(is.na(full_data_clean)))
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
full_data_clean$top30 <- as.factor(full_data_clean$top30)
spotify_train_test <- full_data_clean |> initial_split(prop =  0.7)
spotify_train <- training(spotify_train_test); 
spotify_test  <- testing(spotify_train_test)
```

```{r}
rand_forest_spec <- 
  rand_forest(mtry = 2) |>  
  set_engine('randomForest') |> 
  set_mode('classification')

rf_recipe = recipe(top30~.,
                   data=spotify_train)

rf_wf <- workflow() |> 
  add_recipe(rf_recipe) |> 
  add_model(rand_forest_spec)

rf_wf_fit <- rf_wf |> 
  fit(spotify_train)

rf_wf_fit
```
```{r}
spotify_test_rf <- rf_wf_fit |> 
  augment(spotify_test)

cm_rF <- spotify_test_rf |> 
  conf_mat(truth=top30,
           estimate=.pred_class)
cm_rF
```
```{r}
head(summary(cm_rF),4)
```

```{r}
roc_rF<-roc_curve(spotify_test_rf,
          top30,
          .pred_0,event_level = "first")
roc_rF |> autoplot()
```
